CORRECTION TO THE STANDING REASON, which called the olive balance a frame slip on the grounds that #999966 matches no token. It does: the frame binds Primary/Printers Gold 300 and the same #999966 ships as printersGold and --skai-printers-gold-300 in the shared token set. So the Light card's balance is a deliberate brand colour, not a stray fill, and the ruling above is the cleaner one for it. The card face is a RADIAL, light at the centre, and the frame binds only White, Sky Blue 300 and the two Green Coals - there is no token for the mid cyan, it is a raw stop. The app ships a four-stop 180deg LINEAR running cyan at the top to near-white at the bottom, i.e. the ramp runs the other way, and an oracle pins it vertical (x0 === x1) as the fix for bug f11e1d61. Matching the frame means rewriting that oracle against a radial, which is a deliberate reversal of a closed report and needs the ruling above. Balance is Green Coal 300 here and the app agrees.
